scripts.dev:services:basic: concurrently -n GATEWAY,AUTH-SVC,EMAIL-SVC,USERS-SVC,VEHICLES-SVC,DRIVER-SVC,ROUTES-SVC -c auto "npm run dev:gw" "npm run dev:auth" "npm run dev:email" "npm run dev:users" "npm run dev:vehicles" "npm run dev:drivers" "npm run dev:routes"
